newsitem.title: ITALY: Arthuis says hopes for rapid lira ERM re-entry.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says hopes for rapid lira ERM re-entry.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Friday he hoped for the swift re-entry of the lira into the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM).
"We must have as quickly as possibe the return of the lira at a parity which is sustainable, durable and fair," Arthuis told reporters at the end of a summit between French and Italian leaders.
"I have confidence in the monetary committee," he added.

Earlier Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi indicated he wanted the monetary committee, which will fix the central parity level at which the lira will go back into the ERM, to meet as soon as possible.
The lira crashed out of the ERM in September 1992 and has since lost significant ground against a basket of currencies, including the French franc.

Arthuis, who earlier met his Italian counterpart, Carlo Azeglio Ciampi, said he was impressed by the determination with which Italy was trying to improve its finances and become a founder member of the planned single European currency. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
